Scheduled tasks must exist in the QIKVRT Digital Twin and stay synchronized with their executing scheduler. This PR adds the private durable schedule registry and extends the existing authenticated API shim with an event-driven bridge to the same existing executor ID.

The bridge performs authenticated source read → exact local revision/CAS and durable prepare → conditional update of the existing executor when required → fresh source readback → Twin reconcile → independent persisted local readback. Empty changes import source events without mutation. Stable event IDs bind the exact original request; redelivery freshly reobserves the source. No timer, polling loop, create operation, run-now operation or second executor is introduced.

A private SQLite journal persists PREPARED and ATTEMPTED before the external call. Once attempted, an update is never blindly retried. Restart after an external effect or after reconcile can complete only from matching fresh source bytes. Journal revision advances atomically with reconcile. Drift, stale observations, contradictory versions, reordered/stale revisions, event collisions, concurrent bridge/manual writers and missing authentication fail closed.

The server-configured HttpScheduleExecutor uses scoped, expiring credentials, bounded closed JSON, no redirects and exact repository/principal binding. Mutations require atomic CAS in the source executor's authority domain (If-Match plus stable idempotency key). The currently exposed ChatGPT automations.update tool has no conditional version argument; a gateway using only that operation must advertise conditional_update=false and remains observation-only. The adapter contract does not claim that such a productive CAS gateway or event carrier is already installed.

The supported calendar remains bounded hourly/daily/weekly with IANA timezone binding, gap skipping, first-fold semantics and explicit UTC recurrence.
